input.code:
import pandas as pd

def process(zhvi: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = zhvi.copy()
    df = df.rename(columns={'Unnamed: 0': 'date'})
    df['year'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date']).dt.year
    df = df[df['year'].isin([2005, 2010])]

    # average within year (monthly observations)
    value_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in ['date', 'year']]
    yearly = df.groupby('year')[value_cols].mean(numeric_only=True)

    # ensure both years present
    if 2005 not in yearly.index or 2010 not in yearly.index:
        raise ValueError('ZHVI does not contain both 2005 and 2010')

    lost = (yearly.loc[2005] - yearly.loc[2010]).rename('value_lost').to_frame()
    lost['state'] = lost.index
    lost = lost.reset_index(drop=True)

    # keep only positive losses
    lost = lost[lost['value_lost'] > 0]
    return lost.sort_values('value_lost', ascending=False).head(3)[['state','value_lost']]
input.summary: From ZHVI monthly time series: compute mean ZHVI for years 2005 and 2010 (averaging monthly values), calculate value_lost = mean_2005 - mean_2010 per state, keep positive losses, return top 3 states by value_lost.
